Notes on the plan:
- Kakani shelter is the only designated evacuation point, so all rescues end there. Tarkeshwar school is used only as a waypoint.
- Belkot farm is cut off because the only road out (Uttargaya to Belkot) is closed, so its two adults are deferred (40).
- Myagang market's four adults are deferred (80). The only route is via Naukunda and costs 108 minutes of driving, which is more than the 80-minute penalty.
- Benighat farm's four adults are rescued. The round trip via Tarkeshwar costs 52 minutes, less than the 80-minute penalty.
- Driving totals 130 minutes (car1 52, car2 78). Deferrals total 120. The overall cost is 250.
